media_rules.native-review-input: A selected local input exists; verify provenance, license and artistic choice before public use.
media_rules.placeholder-capture-needed: No showcase image has been selected in this design pass. Placeholder is allowed only in mockups; find existing evidence or capture using an existing native route before release.

architecture_notes: Home is an editorial selection, not the limit of the collection.
Explore is a complete subject-aware index; subject collections add context and variants.
A native executable may own several feature showcases; a gallery film is one media item, not a page taxonomy.
glTF is an importer/renderer feature showcase; the helmet/terrain film is a reference asset, not its identity.
Materials and SDF forms share native services but retain distinct visitor purposes.
The authored static implementation lives under site/. Public hosting, source push and README migration remain separately scoped.
interaction_policy: Start with visible media and ordinary links. Proposed variants are a capture/editorial backlog, not automatic public controls. Keep only useful, media-backed comparisons.

editorial_identity.origin: Reviving an old engine and graphics experiments after earlier C++/OpenGL learning
editorial_identity.direction: Curiosity-led subject selection; careful implementation and review
editorial_identity.collaboration: The author chooses interests and direction and reviews results; coding agents are development collaborators
editorial_identity.foundation: Experiments draw on and contribute back to a growing shared foundation
editorial_identity.method: Understand and apply established techniques, check assumptions and results, refine, restart or cut approaches as needed
presentation_order: Explain selected concrete connections and brief technique cues
Add deeper techniques and development journeys later
editorial_identity.browse_model: Subject categories organise the current collection, not an invented roadmap or curriculum
